title: CCRA regional normalization stats
description: Versioned vmin/vmax (and robust extras) for dual-product regional scoring. City AOI product remains default; this file supplies constants when normalization_domain is a region id.

schema_version.description: Schema major version for this JSON shape.

stats_version.description: Immutable tag for this stats snapshot (v1, v2, …). Bump when recomputing.

created_at.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp when stats were computed.

tool.description: Script or CLI that produced the stats (e.g. compute_regional_norm_stats.py).

type.description: Regional norm ROI. Batch union_bbox is not used for scoring constants.

boundary_path.description: Repo-relative GeoJSON used for the reduce (if local).

gee_asset.description: Optional GEE FeatureCollection/filter expression used for ROI.

bbox.description: Optional envelope of the state polygon (export convenience only).

status.description: pending = placeholders only; partial = some layers filled; ready = safe for regional product runs.

layers.description: Keyed by canonical layer ids from the region YAML / pipeline (pre-norm physical or count fields).

method.description: minmax: (x-vmin)/(vmax-vmin). robust_p95_log1p_minmax: GFD-style (zeros stay 0; positives vs P95 + log1p).

unit.description: Native unit before 0–1 scaling (e.g. celsius, count, mm_day, ndvi, people_per_km2, usd).

vmin.description: Lower bound for minmax (null until computed).

vmax.description: Upper bound for minmax (null until computed).

p95.description: Required for robust_p95_log1p_minmax (P95 of positive counts in ROI).

scale_m.description: Reducer / native scale in meters used when computing stats.

n_samples.description: Pixel or feature count contributing to stats (optional QA).

season.description: Season tag if applicable (e.g. jja, djf).

period.description: Temporal window of the source composite (e.g. 2015-2024).
